text: 1). Enrollment Objects and Qualifications Foreign students who want to study Chinese language or other foreigners who live or work in China. 2). Period of Study Study period is divided into one term or one year; lectures are given on Saturday and Sunday. Each term is no less than 18 weeks. In order to adapt to different students’ special circumstances, students can choose their learning time freely; tuition fee will be calculated monthly. 3). Curriculum Provision Chinese listening, Chinese speaking, Chinese elementary reading, Chinese writing, Chinese grammar, knowledge about Chinese characters, Chinese culture, Chinese humanistic geography, popular science reading, Chinese newspaper reading, Elementary Chinese translation, China's national conditions, modern and contemporary history of China, Chinese customs, Computer-using Chinese editing, etc. 4). Fees Application fee is 660 RMB; Tuition fee is 3,000 RMB per student per semester, 6,000 RMB per student per year. 5).Travelling Study Organize students to visit the scenic spots and historical sites in Beijing and other parts of China in their free time, and let them enjoy the great scenery and experience the extensive and profound Chinese culture. 6). Scholarship All the students learning Chinese, the senior scholars and the visiting scholars in the School of International Education, who apply for the degree education of undergraduate, master and doctor and are accepted by CUPL, can obtain the scholarship. 7). Accommodations Students can live in the students’ apartments arranged by the School of International Education, or solve accommodations by themselves. 8). Completion of Schooling and Entry into a Higher Grade Students, studying in the School of International Education and passing all the relevant tests, will gain the course-completion certificates issued by the school. For the students who expect to apply for the degree education of undergraduate, master or doctor, we will admit the best through examinations
